title: The Theater of Life
preview: A thought experiment on internalized oppression and systemic trauma...
content: i started this as a thought experiment inside my own head, a quiet conversation with myself late one night when i couldn't sleep...
life is a vast and unpredictable theater, and we all find ourselves cast in roles we never auditioned for...
the cost of playing these roles is measured in the currency of human potential.

title: The Kiyosaki Paradox
preview: Critiquing the 'Mindset Shift' as a form of psychological violence...
content: Robert kiyosaki's rich dad poor dad occupies a contradictory and dangerous position...
He transforms a structural problem into an individual one, placing the burden on the poor.
This is not liberation; this is the perfection of oppression.
